landmarks: Block Out Level 48 is a lid-first boss puzzle with a `10` boss chamber in the lower half buried under a horizontal strip of colored blocks including a `4`-counter piece.
Dismantle the lid first — the `4` block is the quickest win — then let the boss drop and sort the revealed late-game colors through the side exits.
The board mixes Yellow, Blue, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The `4`-counter block in the lid is the first quick win — skip it and the lid stays thick.
Expect a second phase: revealed colored blocks spill out after the boss drops.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the `4`-counter block in the upper section first — it is the fastest lid reduction.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Dismantle the remaining yellow, blue, and red lid pieces.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the `10` boss parked while the surrounding counters fall.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the boss once the lid is mostly gone.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Sort the revealed late-game colored blocks through the side exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the side counters after the room is no longer split.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: End with the last cleanup once the boss is gone.

failurePoints: Skipping the `4`-counter block and trying to reduce the `10` boss directly — the lid stays thick and the boss barely moves.
Not having side lanes ready when the boss drops, which jams the revealed blocks.
